# NEW 2026-11-22 v12.5 Worker 4: Little Ice Age, Silver Price Revolution, 12 Parliament Agendas & 6 Authentic Rebel Demands (oe_cri2_, 0 slots, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_v125_crises.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Decision 1: Little Ice Age Grand Granary Relief & Winter Irrigation (repeatable until relief_score >= 3)
oe_cri2_dec_lia_grand_granary_relief = {
	decision_category = economy_decisions
	hide_repeatable_tag = yes
	potential = {
		NOT = { oe_cri2_rule_is_off = yes }
		has_active_disaster = disaster_type:oe_cri2_little_ice_age
		NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_cri2_lia_resilient_agriculture }
	}
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_cri2_player_only_tt
			is_ai = no
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_cri2_lia_relief_cd_tt
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_cri2_lia_relief_cd }
		}
		gold >= 60
	}
	ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
	illustration_tags = { 10 = interior }
	illustration_scope = {
		event_illustration_poptype_effect = {
			foreground = pop_type:peasants
			background = pop_type:burghers
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = oe_cri2_dec_lia_grand_granary_relief.a
		effect = {
			set_variable = { name = oe_cri2_lia_relief_cd months = 24 }
			if = {
				limit = {
					oe_cri2_w1_granary_active = yes
					oe_cri2_rule_is_mild = yes
				}
				change_gold_effect_bounded = { scale = -1.0 min = 25 max = 250 }
				oe_cri2_bump_lia_relief = { amount = 2 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { oe_cri2_w1_granary_active = yes }
				change_gold_effect_bounded = { scale = -1.5 min = 40 max = 400 }
				oe_cri2_bump_lia_relief = { amount = 2 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { oe_cri2_rule_is_mild = yes }
				change_gold_effect_bounded = { scale = -1.5 min = 40 max = 400 }
				oe_cri2_bump_lia_relief = { amount = 1 }
			}
			else = {
				change_gold_effect_bounded = { scale = -3.0 min = 80 max = 800 }
				oe_cri2_bump_lia_relief = { amount = 1 }
			}
			oe_cri2_inject_famine_relief_market = yes
			add_estate_satisfaction = { type = estate_type:peasants_estate value = estate_satisfaction_mild_bonus }
			custom_tooltip = oe_cri2_lia_relief_progress_tt
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = oe_cri2_lia_relief_score
					var:oe_cri2_lia_relief_score >= 3
				}
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_cri2_lia_resilient_agriculture years = 40 mode = replace }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Decision 2: Silver Standard & Sound Coinage Grand Reform (ends Silver Price Revolution)
oe_cri2_dec_silver_standard_reform = {
	decision_category = economy_decisions
	only_once = yes
	only_once_scope = country
	potential = {
		NOT = { oe_cri2_rule_is_off = yes }
		has_active_disaster = disaster_type:oe_cri2_silver_price_revolution
		NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_cri2_silver_standard_reformed }
	}
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_cri2_player_only_tt
			is_ai = no
		}
		OR = {
			inflation < 0.18
			oe_cri2_silver_chao_reformed_ready = yes
		}
		stability >= 5
		gold >= 100
	}
	ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
	illustration_tags = { 10 = interior }
	illustration_scope = {
		event_illustration_poptype_effect = {
			foreground = pop_type:burghers
			background = pop_type:nobles
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = oe_cri2_dec_silver_standard_reform.a
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { oe_cri2_w1_coinage_active = yes }
				change_gold_effect_bounded = { scale = -2.4 min = 60 max = 600 }
				add_stability = stability_weak_penalty
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { oe_cri2_rule_is_mild = yes }
				change_gold_effect_bounded = { scale = -2.0 min = 50 max = 500 }
				add_stability = stability_weak_penalty
			}
			else = {
				change_gold_effect_bounded = { scale = -4.0 min = 100 max = 1000 }
				add_stability = stability_mild_penalty
			}
			add_inflation = inflation_mild_bonus
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_cri2_silver_standard_reformed years = 40 mode = replace }
			custom_tooltip = oe_cri2_silver_reform_effect_tt
		}
	}
}
